 ICAI CA Foundation Result 2026 Live Updates: September marksheet released, check roll number login and download scorecard online 
 LIVE NOW Save Share Comments ICAI CA Foundation Result 2026 Live Updates: September marksheet released, check roll number login and download scorecard online
 THE TIMES OF INDIA | Nov 06, 2026, 10:52:29 IST SUMMARY ICAI CA Foundation Result 2026: How to check September scorecard online, download marksheet and next steps 
 The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) is scheduled to announce the CA Foundation September 2026 result today, November 6, 2026. Candidates who appeared for the examination will be able to check their qualifying status and subject-wise marks through the institute's official examination result website. The result is expected to be declared by the evening, as mentioned in ICAI's official notification. 
 Candidates can access the scorecard by entering their examination roll number and registration number on the result login page. Educational portals have indicated that the result link could become active between 10:00 AM and 11:00 AM IST, although ICAI has officially indicated an evening declaration. Students should keep their examination details ready and use the official portal to access their results. 
 Where to check ICAI CA Foundation September 2026 result 
 ICAI will make the CA Foundation September 2026 scorecard available through its official online services. Candidates can use the following website to check their results: 
 • ICAI Exam Results Portal: https://caresults.icai.org/ 
 • ICAI official website: https://www.icai.org/ 
 The direct result portal is the designated platform for accessing individual marks and qualifying status. Candidates should ensure that they are using the official website before entering their examination credentials. 
 Login credentials required to download the scorecard 
 Before opening the result page, candidates should keep the following information available: 
 1. Roll number: The examination roll number allotted by ICAI. 
 2. Registration number: The registration number issued by the institute, which may carry a regional prefix such as NRO, WRO, SRO, CRO or ERO. 
 3. Captcha code: The security code displayed on the result login screen. 
 Entering the correct details is necessary to access the individual result. Candidates should check their registration and roll numbers against their examination documents before submitting the login form. 
 Steps to check and download CA Foundation result 2026 
 Candidates can follow these steps to access their September examination scorecards: 
 Step 1: Visit the official ICAI result website at https://caresults.icai.org/ . 
 Step 2: Find the link labelled CA Foundation September 2026 Examination Result. 
 Step 3: Click on the result link to open the candidate login window. 
 Step 4: Enter the roll number in the designated field. 
 Step 5: Provide the ICAI registration number. 
 Step 6: Enter the security captcha displayed on the screen. 
 Step 7: Click on the Submit option to view the result. 
 Step 8: The CA Foundation September 2026 scorecard will appear on the screen once the details have been verified. 
 Step 9: Check the marks and qualifying status carefully. 
 Step 10: Download the scorecard in PDF format and take a printout for future reference. 
 ICAI will provide the result online. Candidates should retain a downloaded copy of their scorecard, as physical copies will not be dispatched through the post. 
 Details to check on the ICAI CA Foundation scorecard 
 After downloading the result, candidates should verify the information displayed on the scorecard. The document will provide their examination performance and qualifying status. 
 Students should check their name, roll number, registration details, subject-wise marks, total marks and overall result status. Any discrepancy in the displayed information should be brought to the institute's notice through the prescribed channels. 
 What after CA Foundation September 2026 result? 
 Candidates who qualify for the September 2026 examination can proceed towards CA Intermediate registration. ICAI opened the registration window for the January 2027 CA Intermediate session on November 3, 2026. Eligible students can complete the process through the ICAI Self Service Portal (SSP). 
 The next CA Foundation and CA Intermediate examination session is scheduled to begin on January 2, 2027. 
 Candidates who wish to obtain certified copies of their September 2026 answer sheets or request verification of marks can also look out for the relevant application facility, expected to open during November 2026. 
 The individual result, merit list and other examination-related updates will be accessible through ICAI's official website. Candidates should refer to the institute's announcements for further instructions regarding the post-result process. Live Events

ICAI CA Foundation Result 2026 today: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) is scheduled to announce the CA Foundation September 2026 examination result today, November 6, 2026. Candidates who appeared for the examination will be able to access their scorecards through the official result portal, caresults.icai.org , using their registration number and roll number. The institute has stated in its official notification that the results are likely to be declared by the evening.
However, candidates may see the result link becoming active earlier than the announced timeline. Educational portals have projected that the scorecard link could be available between 10:00 AM and 11:00 AM IST, based on previous result announcements. During an earlier Intermediate examination session, ICAI activated the result link in the morning despite issuing a similar evening declaration notice. The September 2026 pass percentage, gender-wise performance, number of candidates who qualified and All India Rank (AIR) holders' details are expected to be published alongside the results.
 September 2026 pass percentage awaited as ICAI prepares result statistics 
ICAI has not released the September 2026 CA Foundation examination statistics yet. The institute is expected to publish the number of candidates who appeared, the number of successful candidates and the overall pass percentage after declaring the results.
The historical pass percentage for CA Foundation has generally remained within the range of 17% to 21%, although the figures have varied across examination sessions. The May 2026 examination recorded an overall pass percentage of 20.09%, while the January 2026 session registered 19.23%.
The following table presents the available examination statistics:
 Exam session Male pass % Female pass % Overall pass % Total appeared 
 September 2026 Awaited (expected 17%–21%) Awaited Awaited To be released 
 May 2026 20.88% 19.24% 20.09% 90,217 
 January 2026 20.13% 18.26% 19.23% 1,09,694 
 May 2025 N/A N/A 15.09% N/A 
According to ICAI's January 2026 result analysis, 1,09,694 candidates appeared for the Foundation examination, of whom 21,099 qualified. The male pass percentage stood at 20.13%, while female candidates recorded a pass percentage of 18.26%.
In May 2026, a total of 90,217 candidates appeared for the examination, and 18,124 candidates passed. Male candidates recorded a pass percentage of 20.88%, compared with 19.24% among female candidates.
The September 2026 figures will provide the latest information on candidate performance under the current examination scheme.
 CA Foundation September 2026 passing criteria 
Under the existing ICAI examination scheme, candidates must satisfy both the subject-wise and aggregate passing requirements to qualify for the CA Foundation examination.
Candidates are required to secure a minimum of 40% marks in each paper and an aggregate of at least 50% across all four papers. The examination carries a total of 400 marks, making 200 the minimum aggregate required to pass, provided the candidate also meets the minimum requirement in every individual subject.
Candidates securing 70% or more marks are awarded the distinction of 'Pass with Distinction'. Meeting the aggregate requirement alone is not sufficient if a candidate fails to obtain the minimum qualifying marks in any individual paper.
 May 2026 CA Foundation toppers and previous AIR holders 
Alongside the September 2026 result, ICAI is expected to publish the All India merit list and details of the top-performing candidates. The list will provide information about the candidates who secured the highest marks in the examination.
For reference, Sakshi Jain from Nashik secured AIR 1 in the May 2026 CA Foundation examination with 371 marks out of 400, equivalent to 92.75%.
The other leading candidates from the May 2026 session were:

 AIR 1 Sakshi Jain Nashik 371/400 92.75% 
 AIR 2 Ayanabbas Ajani Chandrapur 367/400 91.75%

In the May 2025 session, Vrinda Agarwal secured the first position with 90.5%.
The September 2026 merit list will be available through ICAI's official examination result services once released.
 CA Intermediate January 2027 registration and upcoming examination dates 
Candidates who clear the September 2026 CA Foundation examination can proceed to the next stage of the Chartered Accountancy course by registering for the CA Intermediate programme.
ICAI opened the registration window for the CA Intermediate January 2027 session on November 3, 2026. Eligible Foundation-qualified candidates can complete their registration through the ICAI Self Service Portal (SSP).
The next CA Foundation and CA Intermediate examination session is scheduled to begin on January 2, 2027. Candidates should check the official examination schedule and registration requirements before completing the admission formalities.
Furthermore, the verification of marks and requests for certified copies of September 2026 answer sheets are expected to open during November 2026. Candidates who wish to obtain copies of their evaluated answer sheets or seek verification of marks will be able to follow the applicable ICAI procedure once the facility becomes available.
The September 2026 result, merit list and examination statistics can be checked through the official ICAI result portal at https://caresults.icai.org/ .
